note: The mayoral nominating primary on 2012-06-05 elected the mayor by majority, so it is the decisive election. The county's qualified candidate list for the Nov 6, 2012 general election lists only City Council Districts 2 and 4 and a Charter Commission for the City of Sacramento; it lists no mayoral contest. The cycle comes from the County Elections Office voter information document for Measure A (Nov 2020), archived copy in additional_source_urls (original URL https://elections.saccounty.net/ElectionInformation/Documents/2020-Nov-General/FINAL%20-%20Measure%20A%20-%20City%20of%20Sacramento%20-%20Eng.pdf). Its charter text states that the mayoral office is elected in 2024 and every fourth year thereafter, and that the mayoral term is four years. This gives 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024 by four-year spacing. This is the proposed charter text of Measure A, so the cycle is stated for 2024 onward and 2012 to 2020 follow by the four-year spacing; the vote documents for each year show a mayoral contest. The county list of city officials was removed as a cycle source because it shows only the current mayor. The majority rule is stated in the City Clerk document cited in additional_source_urls (restated as proposed charter text, not the charter page).
